name: Florence

skills.name: Forced Injection
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 6 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK to it

skills.name: Special Care
skills.description: Selects a tile within a 6 tile radius, cleanses 2 debuffs for all allies within a 2 tile radius of the selected tile and restores HP equivalent to 120% ATK

skills.name: Pleasure Trigger
skills.description: Selects an ally within a 6 tile radius, cleanses Fear and Taunt from it, applies Stimulant for 1 round (Duration decreases at the end of the current round) and consumes HP equivalent to 20% initial HP

skills.name: Masochistic Hallucination
skills.description:
Selects a direction, applies Chaos Compound for 2 turns and Infatuated for 1 turn for all enemies within a 3x5 area of the selected direction, and deals AoE Hydro damage equivalent to 80% ATK. After skill usage, increases Confectance Index by 6 points, and teleports Arios near self

If Arios is not on the field, summons Arios after skill usage

skills.name: Surgical Preparation
skills.description:
At the start of the battle, summons Arios near self. At the start of the allied turn, decreases Confectance Index by 3 points. If there is insufficient Confectance Index, Arios disappears

At the end of the action, cleanses Taunt, Fear, Infatuated, and Stun from Arios

summons.name: Arios
summons.description: Has the ability to apply Taunt on the enemy, takes damage on behalf of Florence, and performs Counterattack when Florence or itself receives damage.

skills.name: Precision Anesthesia
skills.description: Applies Chaos Compound on the enemy closest to Florence for 2 turns, deals Hydro damage equivalent to 80% ATK, and applies Taunt for 1 turn

skills.name: No. 1 Assistant
skills.description:
When Florence takes damage, Arios will take all damage on behalf of her

If the distance between Arios and Florence is 6 or more tiles, Arios will be teleported to near Florence

When Arios or Florence receives damage, performs Counterattack, dealing Hydro damage equivalent to 80% ATK. This can be activated twice per round

For each damage instance received, gains 1 stack of Mark of Shame. When the number of stacks of Mark of Shame reaches 5, it is converted into Tremor of Despair

fortification.effect:
Decreases Confectance Index consumption by 1 point

Increases the number of Counterattack through passive skill No. 1 Assistant performed by Arios by 2 times

Enhances the effects of Chaos Compound: Increases Hydro damage received by 15%

New effect is added - Physical damage is dealt to all units at the start of the round

Increases the duration of Stimulant by 1 round (Duration decreases at the end of the current round)

New effect is added - At the end of the action, if HP is below 30%, restores HP equivalent to 100% of Florence's ATK. This effect can only activate once during the duration of Stimulant
Increases damage multiplier by 20%. If Arios is present, restores HP equivalent to 100% ATK for Florence and applies Adrenaline for 1 round (Duration decreases at the end of the current round)
Additionally cleanses Infatuated and Stun. This skill is also applied to Arios

Arios receives 30% less damage

Enhances the effects of Tremor of Despair: Increases ATK by 35%, doubles the damage multiplier of Counterattack, and restores HP equivalent to 30% of damage dealt after dealing damage

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Fatal thrill
keys.effect: At the start of the battle, increases Confectance Index by 3 points

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Self-pleasure
keys.effect: After using active skills, restores HP equivalent to 80% ATK for self and Arios

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Sensitivity Boost
keys.effect: After Florence or Arios attacks, applies Defense Down II on the enemy for 2 turns

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Riposte's Reward
keys.effect: After Arios performs a Counterattack, it gains Attack Up II for 1 turn

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Bondage Urge
keys.effect: Masochistic Hallucination: This skill will pull all targets towards self by 3 tiles

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Sweet Temptation
keys.effect: Special Care: This skill will no longer restore HP and cleanse debuffs, but instead deals AoE Physical damage equivalent to 30% ATK to all units (excluding self) within range

keys.name: Common Key - Master's Command
keys.effect: HP +5% / Increases ATK of holder's Entity Summons by 7%

keys.name: Expansion Key - Thrill Seeker
keys.effect:
After Florence uses the active skill Pleasure Trigger, applies Pleasure Trigger to all ally Entity Summons as well.
When an ally unit gains Stimulant, Arios gains 1 stack of Euphoric Frenzy for 3 turn, this effect has a maximum of 6 stacks. 
After an ally unit with Stimulant receives healing, applies Soak I for 2 turn. 
 
Euphoric Frenzy: For every 1 stack of this effect, the damage caused by Arios' active skill Precision Anesthesia is increased by 10%; when 6 stacks of this effect are collected, owner's critical damage is increased by 20% and the ATK buffed by Tremor of Despair is increased to 2.5 times of the original effect.

source_notes: Extracted from GFL2 Official Release Info Compilation.xlsx with online Dandegate/gfl2.help enrichment.
